name: synthwave-horizon-scene
title: Outrun Wireframe Horizon
description: Scrolling wireframe mountains under a segmented retro sun, with starlight and scanlines over a perspective grid.

name: terminal-deck-scene
title: Retro CRT Cyberdeck OS
description: A live multi-pane terminal console: a rotating wireframe satellite, a scrolling hex dump, a waveform scope and system diagnostics.

name: sacred-torus-scene
title: Sacred Geometry Torus Knot
description: A z-buffered 3D p-q torus knot and morphing polyhedra, shaded with directional edge glyphs.

name: warp-tunnel-scene
title: Relativistic Starfield Tunnel
description: A high-speed wormhole of radially streaking glyphs, with a vanishing point you steer with the pointer.

name: tempest-storm-scene
title: Procedural Lightning & Cumulonimbus
description: Volumetric storm clouds split by branching fractal lightning, with screen-flash bloom and wind-driven rain.

name: fluid-smoke-scene
title: Interactive Curl-Noise Plume
description: A smoke and ink plume driven by curl noise that swirls around the pointer, drawn in Braille or dense ramps.

name: morphogenesis-scene
title: Glyph Morphogenesis
description: Coral, fingerprint and labyrinth patterns growing out of a reaction-diffusion field; the pointer seeds new growth.

name: murmuration-scene
title: Starling Murmuration
description: Thousands of starlings flocking at dusk, folding into ribbons and spheres; the pointer is a hawk they scatter from.

name: woven-banner-scene
title: Woven Banner
description: A cloth banner woven from real words, rippling and folding in the wind; push or grab it with the pointer.

name: circuit-bloom-scene
title: Silicon Bloom
description: Circuit traces growing like vines out of chips, with electrons racing along them; the pointer powers new branches.

name: orrery-scene
title: Clockwork Orrery
description: A brass orrery of meshing gears driving planets on their arms; drag to spin the clockwork faster.

name: hourglass-scene
title: Falling Sand Hourglass
description: Grains of sand pouring through an hourglass that turns itself over; the pointer tilts the glass and the sand follows.
